Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 9803aac7b5508718989e4cde11b854fc01037b01 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Date: Tue, 7 Jan 2020 22:53:19 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] drm/komeda: mark PM functions as __maybe_unused

Without this, we get a couple of warnings when CONFIG_PM
is disabled:

drivers/gpu/drm/arm/display/komeda/komeda_drv.c:156:12: error: 'komeda_rt_pm_resume' defined but not used [-Werror=unused-function]
 static int komeda_rt_pm_resume(struct device *dev)
            ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
drivers/gpu/drm/arm/display/komeda/komeda_drv.c:149:12: error: 'komeda_rt_pm_suspend' defined but not used [-Werror=unused-function]
 static int komeda_rt_pm_suspend(struct device *dev)
            ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Fixes: efb465088518 ("drm/komeda: Add runtime_pm support")
Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Reviewed-by: James Qian Wang (Arm Technology China) <james.qian.wang@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: james qian wang (Arm Technology China) <james.qian.wang@arm.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20200107215327.1579195-1-arnd@arndb.de

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/arm/display/komeda/komeda_drv.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/arm/display/komeda/komeda_drv.c
index ea5cd1e17304..e7933930a657 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/arm/display/komeda/komeda_drv.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/arm/display/komeda/komeda_drv.c
@@ -146,14 +146,14 @@ static const struct of_device_id komeda_of_match[] = {
 
 MODULE_DEVICE_TABLE(of, komeda_of_match);
 
-static int komeda_rt_pm_suspend(struct device *dev)
+static int __maybe_unused komeda_rt_pm_suspend(struct device *dev)
 {
 	struct komeda_drv *mdrv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
 
 	return komeda_dev_suspend(mdrv->mdev);
 }
 
-static int komeda_rt_pm_resume(struct device *dev)
+static int __maybe_unused komeda_rt_pm_resume(struct device *dev)
 {
 	struct komeda_drv *mdrv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/gpu/drm/arm/display/komeda/komeda_drv.c`**
- The functions `komeda_rt_pm_suspend` and `komeda_rt_pm_resume` have been modified to include the `__maybe_unused` attribute. This change indicates that these functions may not be used in all configurations, specifically when `CONFIG_PM` is disabled.
  - Original function declaration:
    ```c
    static int komeda_rt_pm_suspend(struct device *dev)
    ```
    Modified function declaration:
    ```c
    static int __maybe_unused komeda_rt_pm_suspend(struct device *dev)
    ```
  - Original function declaration:
    ```c
    static int komeda_rt_pm_resume(struct device *dev)
    ```
    Modified function declaration:
    ```c
    static int __maybe_unused komeda_rt_pm_resume(struct device *dev)
    ```

### Relationships
- The modifications are aimed at resolving compiler warnings that arise when the `CONFIG_PM` option is disabled. By marking the functions as `__maybe_unused`, the compiler is informed that these functions may not be utilized in certain configurations, thus preventing warnings about them being defined but not used. This change is directly related to the previous commit that added runtime power management support, as indicated by the "Fixes" tag in the patch.

        Root cause:
        The root cause of the bug is that the functions `komeda_rt_pm_suspend` and `komeda_rt_pm_resume` are defined but not used when the `CONFIG_PM` option is disabled. This leads to compiler warnings about unused functions, which are treated as errors due to the `-Werror` flag being enabled. The absence of the `__maybe_unused` attribute causes the compiler to flag these functions as errors in this configuration.
